name: ZX_RULES_B_
description: This table stores the tax rules that are used to determine the outcome of multiple tax determination processes. Each row stores a rule for a specific tax, configuration owner and tax determination process.

columns.name: TAX_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rule code

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax for this rule

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for this rule

columns.name: SERVICE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the tax determination process for this rule

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier for this rule

columns.name: RECOVERY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate recovery type for the tax of this rule

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority in which this rule is evaluated when rules are processed for the same tax and tax determination process

columns.name: DET_FACTOR_TEMPL_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor template code used to evaluate this rule

columns.name: SYSTEM_DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this rule is defaulted by the system during migration

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if this rule is enabled

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: TAX_EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Tax event class code for this rule

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: TAX_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for configuration owner of this rule

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DETERMINING_FACTOR_CQ_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor class qualifier code for this rule

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Geography type code for this rule

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Geography Id for this rule

columns.name: TAX_LAW_REF_CODE
columns.description: Tax law reference code based on which this rule is defined

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_MODE_FLAG
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whther this record is last updated through expert entry mode or guided entry mode. Possible values are E and G.

columns.name: NEVER_BEEN_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if this rule is not enabled even once

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Event class mapping identifier for this rule

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code

columns.name: REPORTING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Foreign key identifier to ZX_REPORTING_TYPES_B. Indicates the reporting type defined for the purpose of tax box numbers.

columns.name: PERIODICITY_CODE
columns.description: Type of the tax box allocation rule ie., whether the tax box rule is applied for periodic tax returns or annual tax returns.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
